description: Defines classes, structs, and functions for allocating and managing UE grants (DL and UL) in a cellular scheduler, including request structures, grant builders, and allocation methods.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator
classes.description: Manages allocation of PDCCH, UCI, PDSCH, and PUSCH PDUs for UE grants within a cell.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator::dl_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Builder interface for setting parameters of a deferred DL grant.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator::ul_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Builder interface for setting parameters of a deferred UL grant.

methods.name: allocate_dl_grant
methods.description: Allocates DL grant for a UE, returning a builder to set PDSCH parameters or a failure cause.

methods.name: allocate_ul_grant
methods.description: Allocates UL grant for a UE, returning a builder to set PUSCH parameters or a status.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Finalizes allocations at the end of a slot, adjusting grants as needed.
